name: approvals_of_a_run_the_tool_opened
why: The tool opened the run, so no server served its approvals.

name: commit_review_of_a_run_the_tool_opened
why: The tool opened the run, so no server served its commit review.

name: approvals_of_a_run_the_tool_opened_whose_pre_deploy_stage_is_pending
why: run_opened_locally comes before pre_deploy_pending: no server will ever serve approvals to this run.

name: approvals_of_a_run_the_tool_opened_whose_stage_read_none
why: run_opened_locally comes before the stage's own result, here the marker that it read no approvals.

name: approvals_a_server_opened_run_needed_and_did_not_get
why: The server opened the run and the pre-deploy stage kept the unknown marker where a check needed its approvals.

name: exceptions_of_a_run_that_relied_on_a_project_exception
why: An event names an exception from the project's own exceptions file; it comes before run_opened_locally and pre_deploy_pending.

name: exceptions_of_a_server_opened_run_relying_on_no_exception
why: The server opened the run, its plan stage applied the exceptions the server served, and no failed result relies on one.

name: reference_time_of_a_run_on_the_runners_clock
why: Every stage took its time from the runner's clock, so no trusted time source was used.

name: reference_time_of_a_run_on_the_servers_time
why: Every stage took the time the server gave, the record's own claim.

name: evaluator_binary_of_a_record_on_a_placeholder_binary
why: Its OPA evaluations name a placeholder digest, not the pinned binary for their platform.

name: evaluator_binary_of_a_record_on_the_pinned_binary
why: Every OPA evaluation names the pinned binary for its platform.

name: exceptions_of_a_run_that_relied_on_a_project_exception_with_its_pre_deploy_stage_out_of_scope
why: The plan stage relied on an exception from the project's own exceptions file; it comes before pre_deploy_out_of_scope, which would otherwise hide it.

name: bundle_provenance_of_a_run_the_tool_opened
why: The run the tool opened evaluated the assertions it was given locally, so no stage names the server's bundle.

name: bundle_provenance_of_a_server_opened_run
why: A run the server opened evaluates only assertions from the server's bundle, and each stage names it.

name: exceptions_of_a_server_opened_run_relying_on_an_exception_its_run_starter_approved_with_pre_deploy_pending
why: The plan stage names failed results exceptions the server served cover, and the kept copy says the person who approved one of them started the run. The exception results come before the pre-deploy stage's pending one, so the pending stage does not hide them.

name: scanner_evidence_of_a_record_with_no_scanner_report
why: No stage read a scanner report and none requires one.

name: scanner_evidence_of_a_record_whose_reports_the_pipeline_ran
why: The plan stage read reports the pipeline ran, and its scanner verdicts follow from the files it kept: the pipeline's word.

name: scanner_evidence_of_a_record_whose_required_scanner_group_gave_only_gaps
why: A group of scanners the plan stage requires gave only gaps for a check and subject, so the scan the run required did not happen for it.

name: exceptions_of_a_governed_run_relying_on_no_served_exception
why: The server opened the run, its plan stage applied the exceptions the server served it, and no failed result relies on one.

name: exceptions_of_a_governed_run_relying_on_served_exceptions
why: The plan stage names failed results exceptions the server served cover, the kept copy gives them, and no one who approved them started the run.

name: scanner_evidence_of_a_governed_run_with_no_scanner_report
why: No stage of the run the server opened read a scanner report, and none requires one; only the server confirms that.

name: approvals_of_a_governed_run_the_server_served_an_approval_for
why: The pre-deploy stage of the run the server opened lists the approval the server served.

name: commit_review_of_a_governed_run_whose_commits_were_reviewed
why: The pre-deploy stage kept the commit review the server served, and every commit it counts was reviewed.

name: approvals_of_a_governed_run_whose_server_facts_were_unavailable
why: The server opened the run, its approval check needed the approvals, and the stage kept the unknown marker in their place.

name: commit_review_of_a_governed_run_whose_server_facts_were_unavailable
why: The server opened the run, its commit review check needed the review, and the stage kept the unknown marker in its place.

name: reference_time_of_a_governed_plan_with_a_check_undecided
why: The plan stage, which blocks on a check it left undecided, took its time from the server.
